name: Hirocato
subtitle: The Delivery Hero
tagline: Race the clock. Rule the streets.
shortDescription: A fast-paced arcade delivery game starring Hiro — a hero racing against the clock through vibrant city streets.
description: Play as Hiro, a delivery hero racing against the clock through vibrant city streets. Every second counts — master your routes, outpace rivals, and make the drop before time runs out.
Compete across story mode, high-score arcade runs, and ghost races where you chase down your own best time. Top the leaderboards and prove you're the fastest courier in the city.
features: Story mode with narrative progression across city districts
Arcade mode for pure high-score chasing
Ghost race — race against recordings of your own best runs
Multiple routes and delivery zones to master

team.name: Gabriel Colmenares
team.bio: Mobile software engineer turned indie game developer. Sole developer on Hirocato — designed, coded, and shipped.
